findings.title: Un-delta'd orbit-onboard baseline pins 'three execution disciplines' — contradicted by the fourth (no-chaining) discipline this change adds
findings.recommendation: The baseline scenario 'Enumerates orbit-distinctive layers' (Identity statement section) requires onboard's prose to name 'three execution disciplines (read-before-reference / change completeness / pushback)'. This change's orbit-conventions ADDED requirement makes the no-chaining contract a discipline 'echoed in every generated workflow body (the self-contained-disciplines pattern)' and tasks.md 2.5 installs it as 'the FOURTH disciplines entry' in all 15 bodies including onboard's. Post-apply the regenerated onboard body either keeps 'three' (factually wrong, contradicting the conventions echo) or says 'four' (violating its own un-delta'd baseline scenario). Same class as every prior CRITICAL in this cadence (un-delta'd baseline text contradicting new behavior); repo-wide baseline grep confirms orbit-onboard/spec.md:56 is the only remaining 'three execution disciplines' carrier. Add a specs/orbit-onboard/spec.md MODIFIED block for 'Identity statement section' updating the enumeration to four execution disciplines (read-before-reference / change completeness / pushback / no-chaining), and extend task 2.4 (or add a task) to cover the onboard identity-prose count alongside the stock-phrasing relabel; update proposal.md's capability list (6 -> 7 modified, 13 -> 14 stays correct for total count only if worded per-capability).

findings.title: proposal.md says 'the position-readout / single-voiced canonical-next requirements adopt eligibility phrasing' (plural) but only the single-voiced requirement is delta'd
findings.recommendation: The orbit-engine-gates delta modifies 'Single-voiced canonical-next computation' only; the baseline 'Gate-aware status and instructions with position readout' requirement is untouched (defensibly — it pins no label; the eligibility rule in the single-voiced block already covers status output and instructions rendering). Reword the bullet to name the one modified requirement, e.g. 'the single-voiced canonical-next requirement adopts eligibility phrasing (Ready when you are:) and surfaces the consent marker', so an implementer does not hunt for a nonexistent position-readout delta.
